text: The third tank, 1,500 s in: 1,617 alive.
All three tanks bloomed, then lost a fifth to nearly half.
Chapter 3: The eaters arrive.
Gastrella cidutis: a newcomer stomach, one round part, no leaf.
It landed 157 s ago, with 72 J to start on.
Its first child came half a second after landing.
It eats 1.25 W and spends 0.50 W.
Eleven minutes after it landed, its line is 24 strong.
Last round, most founders like it died within a minute.
Chapter 4: The eaters fall.
The third tank, 6,500 s.
The last of Gastrella cidutis, 2,655 s old.
It eats 0.55 W and spends 0.73 W.
It has 9 J left.
In the run it starved 45 s later, and the line ended.
Chapter 8: The end.
The third tank, 3,000 s: 954 alive.
The big-child leaf, Thallus legatribens, holds 72%.
The small-child leaf, Thallus migugis, has 27%, and rising.
Joints: 584 bodies had one at 3,000 s. Now 7.
